40. 若一正四面體的高為 2 cm，則該四面體的體積為

A. $2\text{ cm}^3$。
B. $\sqrt{3}\text{ cm}^3$。
C. $\sqrt{6}\text{ cm}^3$。
D. $3\sqrt{3}\text{ cm}^3$。
reasoning: For a regular tetrahedron with side length $a$, the height $h$ is given by $h = \sqrt{\frac{2}{3}}a$. Given $h = 2\text{ cm}$, we have $2 = \sqrt{\frac{2}{3}}a \Rightarrow a = \frac{2\sqrt{3}}{\sqrt{2}} = \sqrt{6}\text{ cm}$. The volume $V$ of a regular tetrahedron is $V = \frac{1}{3} \times (\text{Base Area}) \times h$. The base is an equilateral triangle with side $a$, so its area is $\frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}a^2$. Thus, $V = \frac{1}{3} \cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4} a^2 \cdot h = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{12} \cdot (\sqrt{6})^2 \cdot 2 = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{12} \cdot 6 \cdot 2 = \sqrt{3}\text{ cm}^3$.
